title: Martha, sit: For Church Teams
shortDescription: Plan your church’s serving schedule together, and get notified when you serve.
fullDescription:
No more digging through group chats to find your church’s serving schedule.
With Martha, sit, team members open the app and see when they serve and what they’re doing. Whoever plans the schedule can put it together with everyone else.

FOR TEAM MEMBERS
• Open Home to see your upcoming serving
• Get notified when you’re put on the schedule
• Get a reminder before you serve

FOR WHOEVER PLANS THE SCHEDULE
• Plan it together with other team members, and everyone sees changes right away
• Snap a photo of a paper schedule to import it
• Connect your church’s Google Calendar to view and edit events in the app
• Send an invite link, and team members tap it to join your church

USE IT ANYWHERE
• Works on iPhone, Android, and the web
• No ads
